anomalies.description: A black sports car collides with the rear of a semi-truck while attempting to pass or maneuver alongside it; the car is visibly wedged under the trailer in frames f2–f4.

The black sports car, still attached to or in close contact with the truck, sustains further impact or loss of control, evidenced by severe motion blur, smoke/dust, and the driver’s strained posture (f13–f15).
A black sports car collides with a large truck, flips violently into the air, and tumbles multiple times while generating a large dust cloud.

A dark sedan collides with a large truck, flips violently into the air, and tumbles multiple times across dusty terrain before coming to rest heavily damaged and partially buried in dust and debris.; Interior shot showing a driver (Vin Diesel) reacting with extreme vocalization and facial expression during or immediately after the crash; consistent with being in the vehicle during the accident sequence.
A dark-colored sedan is shown overturned on its roof in a field of dry grass, with dust still settling around it, indicating the crash has just occurred and the vehicle is stationary post-impact.

A car is shown overturned on its roof in a dusty field, with dust still settling, indicating a recent crash. The vehicle remains stationary across frames f0–f6, confirming the accident has already occurred and is not ongoing motion.

A person emerges from the left side of the frame and runs toward the overturned car; at 41.5s (f11), they are seen raising their arm in a striking motion toward another person who is near or emerging from the vehicle, suggesting the start of a physical confrontation.

A close-up shows a person (likely the one previously running) crouched beside the overturned car, appearing to strike or subdue another individual who is partially visible under the vehicle’s chassis; the posture and proximity suggest an attack on a vulnerable, possibly trapped person.

Two individuals engage in physical combat next to the overturned car: one person (male, wearing dark tank top with red '8') grabs and lifts another (female, topless) from the ground, then hoists her over his shoulder/hip in a wrestling-style takedown or carry. The interaction is mutual and forceful, with visible grappling and body control, consistent with fighting rather than rescue or assistance.
